data.long_meaning: The meaning of Herrod is recorded in name-lists as “Famous hero, ruler”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Herrod total 41, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: חרית
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Herrod is derived from the Hebrew word 'heret' or 'heret hacodash', meaning 'mountain goat' or 'wild goat of the gods'. In the context of the Bible, it is used to refer to the Edomite king Herod the Great and his successors.

in_greek.name: Ἡρὼδ
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Herrod in Greek is derived from the word 'heros', meaning 'hero'. In the Bible, it is used to refer to Herod the Great, the king of Judea who ruled during the time of Jesus' birth and early ministry.

in_latin.name: Herodes
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Herrod in Latin is also derived from 'heros', meaning 'hero'. It was commonly used to refer to the Herodian dynasty, which ruled over Judea and other territories during New Testament times.
